text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: The autumn Tenno Sho is here at last. I've got my work cut out for me, going up against Opera O and Doto, but there has to be a way!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: And then, suddenly, it starts raining! But for someone like me who runs on any track, I can work with poor conditions! In fact, that's where I excel! LET'S GET IIIT!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: I'll show 'em the tenacity of the All-Rounder! That's right! A hero doesn't choose their battlefield!
